question: The last Indian Olympic games were held in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The last Indian Olympic Games, known as the All India Olympic Games, were held in Calcutta.
 
• The event took place in 1948, post-independence, and was a precursor to the modern-day National Games of India.
 
• These games were organized by the Indian Olympic Association (IOA), established in 1927.
 
• The event aimed to promote sports and identify talent for international competitions, including the Olympics.
 
• Delhi has historically been a significant venue for various national and international sports events in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Games of India**

 
 
• These games are a multi-sport event held every four years in India.
 
• The Indian Olympic Association organizes the event, and the first edition was held in Lahore in 1924.
 
• The games are designed to promote sports and provide a platform for athletes to showcase their talent.
 
• Various states and Union territories of India participate in the National Games.
 
 
 
• **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)**
 
 
• It is the governing body for the Olympic Movement and the Commonwealth Games in India.
 
• The IOA is responsible for selecting athletes to represent India at the Olympic Games, Asian Games, and other international competitions.
 
• The association also works to develop and promote sports throughout the country.
 
 
 
• **Post-Independence Sports Development**
 
 
• Post-independence, India has made significant strides in sports, with increased government support and infrastructure development.
 
• Various sports schemes and programs have been launched to nurture young talent.
 
• India has hosted and participated in numerous international sports events, gaining recognition and success in various disciplines.
 
 
 
• **Sports Infrastructure in Delhi**
 
 
• Delhi has several world-class sports facilities, including the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium and the Indira Gandhi Arena.
 
• The city hosted the 2010 Commonwealth Games, showcasing its capability to organize large-scale international events.
